mapper.sql: id, uid, memory_id, user_id, source_agent_id, item_key, namespace, fact_key, value_type, value_json, value_hash, context_json, context_hash, record_type, confidence, sensitivity, status, observed_at, valid_until, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_memory_items (uid, memory_id, user_id, source_agent_id, item_key, namespace, fact_key, value_type, value_json, value_hash, context_json, context_hash, record_type, confidence, sensitivity, status, observed_at, valid_until, version) VALUES (#{uid}, #{memoryId}, #{userId}, #{sourceAgentId}, #{itemKey}, #{namespace}, #{factKey}, #{valueType}, #{valueJson}, #{valueHash}, #{contextJson}, #{contextHash}, #{recordType}, #{confidence}, #{sensitivity}, #{status}, #{observedAt}, #{validUntil}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE namespace = VALUES(namespace), fact_key = VALUES(fact_key), value_type = VALUES(value_type), value_json = VALUES(value_json), value_hash = VALUES(value_hash), context_json = VALUES(context_json), context_hash = VALUES(context_hash), record_type = VALUES(record_type), confidence = VALUES(confidence), sensitivity = VALUES(sensitivity), status = VALUES(status), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), valid_until = VALUES(valid_until), version = version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_memory_items SET status = 'RETRACTED', version = version + 1 WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId} AND item_key = #{itemKey}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM profile_memory_items item WHERE item.user_id = #{userId} AND item.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONFLICTED') AND (item.valid_until IS NULL OR item.valid_until > NOW()) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memories memory WHERE memory.id = item.memory_id AND memory.user_id = #{userId} AND memory.memory_type = 'USER_PROFILE' AND memory.sharing_scope = 'USER_AGENTS' AND memory.status = 'VISIBLE' ) ORDER BY namespace, fact_key, updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_memory_items item JOIN ( SELECT user_id, namespace, fact_key, context_hash, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT value_hash) > 1 THEN 'CONFLICTED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS resolved_status FROM profile_memory_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONFLICTED') AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > NOW()) GROUP BY user_id, namespace, fact_key, context_hash ) resolved ON resolved.user_id = item.user_id AND resolved.namespace = item.namespace AND resolved.fact_key = item.fact_key AND resolved.context_hash = item.context_hash SET item.status = resolved.resolved_status WHERE item.user_id = #{userId} AND item.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONFLICTED') AND (item.valid_until IS NULL OR item.valid_until > NOW())
